text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-91234 fired for scale-controller backlog (service: inference-queue) — queue depth > 95% (5m avg). Trigger: kvcache/warmup-delay + scale-controller failed to provision new nodes. Link: https://pd.example/INC-91234
claire: acked. I'm on it. gathering quick metrics
mike: seeing influx ~18k req/min from us-west-2, p95 latency jumping 2.3s -> 11.8s, error 503s rising. Queue backlog at ~24k messages.
ajay: I can check the autoscaler logs, looks like provider API rate limit errors earlier. grabbing logs now.
claire: good — call out customer impact if we have. @customer-success-bot any alerts from customers?
customer-success-bot: PM for "NorthStar" reported elevated 5xx in their dashboard starting ~4567891180. No official ticket yet; auto-alert created.
pd-bot: PagerDuty notification: INC-91234 escalated to on-call after no ack for 30s (auto rules).
ajay: logs snippet:```ERROR provisioner: failed to create instance: QuotaExceeded: InsufficientCPUs in region us-west-2 for instance type p4d. Request 8 vCPUs, available 0
2026-03-15T10:41:20Z scale-controller: provider rate limit 429 on CreateFleet```
claire: that matches. autoscaler kept hitting provider 429s and backoff grew; scale-controller entered backoff and stopped scaling. we have nodes available on other regions though.
mike: we can try two things immediately: 1) manual spin-up of smaller nodes in us-west-2 (g4dn) for short-term capacity; 2) route new workload to us-east-1 for non-low-latency customers.
claire: manual spin-up approved. I'll run a constrained spin-up: terraform apply --target=module.fleet.g4dn-temp -var=instance_count=6
ajay: I'm going to temporarily lower the target batch size in the inference-routing service to reduce per-request GPU load. patching config now:
```yaml
route: /v1/generate
max_batch_tokens: 512 -> 256
max_batch_size: 64 -> 32
```
sam: adding a fallback rule to send lower-cost model variant for heavy users: `model: rdlw-small-v0` for requests >1000 tokens or unknown tenant. that should cut token usage ~3x. deploying canary.
claire: running kubectl rollout status for scale-controller...
claire: rollout stalled for scale-controller-controller-manager, investigating.
ajay: the provider quota path is the blocker; terraform apply returned: `Error: RequestLimitExceeded` then `QuotaExceeded`. ops support pinged provider for quota increase (ticket TKT-8891). response ETA ~20m.
mike: meanwhile I kicked an emergency replica set for the queue-consumer to 12 replicas manually: `kubectl scale deployment/queue-consumer --replicas=12 -n inference-prod` — consumers picked up backlog but CPU spiked. We should watch OOMs.
claire: monitoring OOM and OOS, but backlog drain started to slow; backlog reduced from 24k -> 14k in 6m. p95 down to 6.2s.
customer-success-bot: Notifying impacted tenants: "NorthStar" flagged, email sent to their SRE.
pd-bot: INC-91234 acknowledged by claire at 4567891235.
sam: can we enable routing fallback to alternative region? I hacked a patch to set route-policy for low-pri to us-east-1 as emergency: `redwood route set --policy low-pri --region us-east-1`
claire: applied. traffic rebalanced ~30% to us-east-1 for low-priority tenants. we saw additional relief: backlog -> 9k.
ajay: provider ticket update: provisional quota granted for 6 g4dn instances, ETA 6m.
mike: spun up the 6 g4dn nodes manually (kube node autoscaler didn't trigger); kube recognized nodes and pods scheduled. consumers now at 18 replicas. backlog -> 3.2k, p95 ~3.1s.
claire: good. customer-impact summary for PD/CS: partial degradation for ~14 minutes starting 4567891180; some enterprise tenants observed 5xx and elevated latency. We're sending follow-up to customers flagged.
sam: started a quick smoke eval against fallback model to ensure quality regressions are acceptable for auto fallback — passed for core prompts.
claire: next steps: 1) keep auto-scale backoff reset (we need to clear scale-controller backoff window) 2) postmortem + provider quota backlog 3) consider cross-region prewarming policy for busy tenants. I'll hand off to ajay for follow-up.
ajay: taking over. will post detailed timeline and collect logs. creating postmortem tracker: https://redwood-incidents/INC-91234-pm
claire: handing off. oncall rotation: @sam you will be second responder for the next 30m.
sam: ack, watching.
customer-success-bot: CS notified 3 tenants (NorthStar, BlueFin, DataCo).
claire: marking incident as mitigated for immediate customer impact. keeping PD open until scale-controller autoscale behavior verified and postmortem assigned.
pd-bot: INC-91234 status: Mitigated (ack by claire). Escalation canceled.
ajay: last check: queue depth steady at 1.1k, p95 2.0s. provider ticket updated with logs. will follow up with quota request and automation to avoid future single-region saturation.
claire: thanks all. follow-up items on the postmortem: - fix backoff logic to allow controlled retries - cross-region warm pools - better tenant-aware routing thresholds - alert to include provider quota error signals
sam: adding runbook note: if provider 429s detected, temporarily reduce batch sizes and enable fallback-model routing.
claire: closing thread; moving to postmortem channel. :wave:
